about.text: Halloumi, or haloumi, is a type of dairy product made with milk originating from Cyprus. It is traditionally made from a mixture of goat milk and sheep's milk; however, due to lower cost of cow's milk and price sensitivity of consumers, modern halloumi increasingly contains cow's milk.

facts.v: Pieces boiled in hot whey for at least 30 minutes, which gives the texture; then salted, garnished with mint and kept in salted whey 1 to 3 days
Traditionally shaped into round forms and aged briefly before cooking; made mainly in the Bekaa Valley and south Lebanon, in late spring and early summer
